name: Leil Como 120 1-Person Indoor Sauna Kit
description: Leil Como 120 1-Person Indoor Sauna Features Premium 40mm ThermoWood® Construction : Thermally modified Scandinavian pine walls provide superior insulation, resistance to moisture and humidity, and exceptional durability for years of reliable daily use without warping or resin leakage. Compact 1-Person Design : Space-efficient footprint measuring 1.2 meters (4 feet) wide and under 2.2 meters tall, perfect for modern apartments, home bathrooms, wellness rooms, and indoor recreational spaces. Tempered Glass Front Door : Clear 8mm tempered glass door with premium black hardware and hinges creates an open, airy feel while maintaining heat retention and safety standards for daily wellness sessions. Smooth Aspen & Alder Benches : 2-step bench configuration with naturally cool-to-the-touch wood that resists heat transfer, providing exceptional comfort during extended sauna sessions without burning skin. Insulated Ceiling with ThermoWood® : 15mm thermally modified ceiling panels enhance heat retention and efficiency, ensuring consistent warmth distribution from top to bottom throughout your sauna experience. Vertical Bar Front Wall Design : Clean, minimalist architectural detail creates an elegant Scandinavian aesthetic while providing structural integrity and modern visual appeal to any interior environment. Engineered Airflow System : Adjustable ceiling vent and elevated base airflow design maintain oxygen-rich circulation and prevent uncomfortable dry heat sensation, allowing longer, deeper therapeutic sessions. Optional LED Lighting & DECO Panels : Customizable ambient lighting and hexagon mosaic panels transform your sauna into a serene wellness sanctuary with personalized ambiance and spa-quality relaxation atmosphere. Modular Pre-Fabricated Kit : Easy-to-assemble panel construction allows two people to complete assembly in 4-6 hours without professional installation, using included fasteners and basic tools. Nordic Craft Heritage : Handcrafted in Estonia with 16+ years of sauna engineering expertise, combining contemporary design with traditional Nordic sauna culture and testing standards. Leil Como 120 Specifications Product Name Leil Como 120 1-Person Indoor Sauna Kit Capacity 1 person Exterior Width 1,200mm (47.2 inches) Exterior Depth 1,200mm (47.2 inches) Exterior Height 2,200mm (86.6 inches / 7.2 feet) Wall Thickness 40mm (1.57 inches) ThermoWood® Ceiling Insulation 15mm STS ThermoWood® insulated panels Interior Volume Approximately 1.0-1.2 cubic meters Door Size Clear tempered 8mm glass with black hardware Bench Configuration 2-step Aspen & Alder bench system Estimated Weight 400-500 kg (880-1,100 lbs) assembled Shipping Method LTL freight curbside delivery (crated) Assembly Time 4-6 hours with 2-3 people (3 person recommended for glass door) Warranty 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering materials, manufacturing defects, and pre-transport damage Material Standards Nordic Lunawood ThermoWood®, tempered glass, stainless steel hardware Design Awards Red Dot: Best of the Best 2024 design recognition Ventilation Adjustable ceiling vent and elevated base airflow system Heater Compatibility Optional electric heaters (heater sold separately, recommend 3-6kW capacity) Electrical Requirements 220-240V hardwired connection with dedicated breaker (electric heater model dependent) Floor Surface Required Stable, level ground with concrete foundation or driven piles (installation required) Customization Options Standard or Hexagon DECO panel back wall, LED lighting packages, various heater options Leil Como 120 Frequently Asked Questions Is the Como 120 suitable for small apartments or bathrooms? Yes, the Como 120 is specifically designed for compact indoor spaces. Its 1.2m x 1.2m footprint and 2.2m height make it ideal for modern apartments, home bathrooms, wellness rooms, or any space-constrained environment. The clear glass door creates an open, airy aesthetic that complements contemporary interior design. However, you'll need a stable, level concrete floor or foundation for proper installation and to ensure structural stability. What heater should I pair with the Como 120, and are heaters included? Heaters are sold separately and not included with the sauna kit. For the Como 120's compact 1.0-1.2 cubic meter volume, we recommend electric heaters in the 3-6kW capacity range, such as HUUM or Saunum models that are specifically engineered for Leil saunas. These heaters provide balanced airflow (mixing hot ceiling air with cooler floor air) to eliminate "cold feet" and create the authentic Estonian "leil" steam experience. Consult the manufacturer's recommendations or speak with sales for your specific heater selection. How difficult is assembly, and do I need professional installation? The Como 120 uses pre-fabricated modular panels that are easier to align than traditional barrel staves, allowing two capable people to assemble the kit in 4-6 hours. A third person is strongly recommended when handling the heavy tempered glass door for safety. No professional installation is required if you have basic tools and follow the included instruction manual. However, you will need to prepare a stable, level concrete foundation in advance as part of your site preparation. What is ThermoWood® and why is it better than regular cedar? ThermoWood® is heat-treated Scandinavian pine modified using only heat and steam (no chemicals) to remove internal moisture and resins. This creates a wood that is naturally resistant to warping, shrinking, rotting, and insect damage—far superior to untreated cedar or hemlock. ThermoWood® also won't leak sticky resin even in extreme heat, maintains dimensional stability for years without twisting, and develops a beautiful natural patina over time. The 40mm thickness in the Como 120 provides exceptional insulation and durability compared to standard sauna materials. Does the Como 120 include a warranty, and what does it cover? The Como 120 comes with a comprehensive 2-year manufacturer's warranty that covers defects in materials, manufacturing quality, and any damage occurring before transportation. The warranty does not cover natural wood variations (such as color changes, cracks, or knots), normal wear and tear from regular use, incorrect assembly/installation, force majeure events (natural disasters or wars), or unauthorized modifications. Claims should be filed within the warranty period by contacting the manufacturer with photographic documentation of the defect. Can I customize the Como 120 with lighting or decorative panels? Yes, the Como 120 offers several customization options to personalize your sauna experience. You can add optional ambient LED lighting systems to create a serene wellness atmosphere. The standard back wall can be upgraded to a beautiful Hexagon DECO panel option (as shown in product variants) that adds visual elegance and spa-quality ambiance. These customizations can be selected during purchase or may be available as add-ons, allowing you to tailor your sauna to match your wellness space design preferences. What are the electrical and site preparation requirements? The Como 120 requires a stable, level floor prepared with a concrete foundation or driven piles to ensure structural integrity and prevent settling. The sauna itself requires a 220-240V hardwired connection with a dedicated breaker for any electric heater (specific amperage depends on heater model). A dedicated 120V connection is also recommended for LED lighting and control systems. We recommend confirming exact electrical specifications with a qualified electrician based on your chosen heater before installation to ensure compliance with local building codes. How long will the Como 120 last, and what maintenance is required? With proper care, the Como 120 can provide decades of reliable performance thanks to its ThermoWood® construction and premium materials. Annual maintenance is recommended: apply UV-protective varnish to the exterior to maintain color and protect against weathering, and treat wooden benches with specialized sauna bench oils for smooth, long-lasting comfort. The glass door and hardware require only routine cleaning. Avoid harsh chemicals and ensure proper ventilation during use. Regular maintenance preserves the sauna's beauty, durability, and structural integrity throughout its lifetime. What is included in the delivery, and how is shipping handled? The Como 120 is shipped fully crated via LTL (less-than-truckload) freight for curbside delivery to the lower 48 states (special arrangements available for other locations). The delivery includes the complete pre-fabricated sauna kit with all wall panels, ceiling elements, door, benches, hardware, and assembly instructions. Upon delivery, the driver will unload the crate at curb-side—you'll need to unpack it and move components with at least two people (30-45 minutes). Optional heaters and accessories typically ship separately. Inspect the crate for visible damage before signing delivery paperwork and report any concealed damage within 5 business days.
